name: COBBLEVERSE 1.7.42
changelog:
![COBBLEVERSE 1.7.42 Update](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/62db693564c4863cb3c0656e6144bfed0e4768dc_0.webp)
## COBBLEVERSE 1.7.42
### 🛠️ Fixes & Tweaks

#### Recipes & Crafting
* **Vanilla Chest:** Restored the ability to craft standard vanilla chests
* **Custom Wooden Chests:** Crafting non-vanilla wooden chest variants now requires 1 vanilla button (any wood type) in the center surrounded by 8 planks
* **Hoppers:** Hoppers can now be crafted using any type of chest, not just standard Minecraft ones

#### Pokémon, Models & Riding
* **Rayquaza:** Now has recovered its full speed!
* **Ferrothorn:** Fixed its model issues
* **Mega Blaziken:** Fixed both model and riding position
* **Zekrom & Reshiram:** Recalibrated riding statistics
* **Terapagos:** Tweaked and rebalanced spawn rates and catch rate parameters
* **Hisuian Bergmite:** Added its spawn in the world
* **Zygarde:** Fixed a bug where changing forms would reset its moveset and wipe applied PP Up / PP Max boosts
* **Greninja:** Fixed model and riding position for Mega Greninja
* **Okidogi:** Applied the correct texture for its Shiny form
* **Victini:** Fixed missing particle textures for V-Create
* **Aegislash:** Fixed battle animation
* **Rabsca:** Fixed texture bugs
* **Arctovish:** Fixed riding position

#### Gameplay, Spawning & UI
* **General Spawning:** Adjusted spawn mechanics to prevent 2 identical Pokémon from spawning simultaneously on the exact same spot (especially in water)
* **World Stability:** Added a safety system that catches ticking entity errors to prevent world-corrupting crashes
* **Battle UI:** Added dynamic stat change indicators during battles
* **Waystones:** Fixed a game crash that occurred when deleting a Waystone

---

### 🔄 Updated Mods
* Carved Wood
* Fabric API
* Fabric Language Kotlin
* FancyMenu
* Waystones
* Xaero’s Minimap
* Xaero’s World Map

### ➕ Added Mods
* Neruina
* Particular Reforged

### ➖ Removed Mods
* Particular

---

> A massive **thank you to everyone** for all your bug reports on our **[Discord](https://discord.lumy.fun)**! Around 90% of this update was made possible thanks to your detailed reports regarding errors and visual glitches. We're still catching up on all the feedback and suggestions sent during our absence, but we're extremely grateful for your ongoing support!

name: COBBLEVERSE 1.7.41b
changelog:
🚨 DO NOT INSTALL version 1.7.40. Please skip it and update directly to this version.

## COBBLEVERSE 1.7.41

### 🛠️ Fixes and Improvements

* ⚡ **Severe Lag & Performance:** Resolved the major lag spikes and framerate drops introduced in the last version. We have downgraded **Rechiseled** and **Fusion** to their previous versions, as they were the main cause of the performance issues
* 💻 **4GB RAM Compatibility:** Optimized memory usage so players allocating 4GB of RAM can now load worlds quickly and play smoothly again (we still recommend **6GB+** for optimal performance, but 4GB should now be fully playable)
* 🐉 **Multi-Passenger Mounts:** Rayquaza can now carry up to **4 players** simultaneously!
* ✨ **Visual Improvements:** Updated customized shaders to their latest versions for better visual performance

### 🔄 Updated

The following mods have been updated to their latest stable versions:
* Balm
* Carved Wood
* FancyMenu

## COBBLEVERSE 1.7.41b

* **Xaero's Minimap & World Map Downgrade:** We have rolled back both mods to their previous versions to prevent startup crashes in server environments

---

> 💬 **A note from LUMYVERSE:**
> We deeply apologize for the performance issues and lag many of you experienced with our last update. Every PC configuration is unique, and during our pre-release testing on our own machines, we didn't encounter any of these lag spikes. 
> 
> We sincerely hope this patch fully resolves the situation. We highly recommend everyone download this version as soon as possible and let us know on our **[Discord Server](https://discord.lumy.fun)** if performance has improved for you! Your feedback is incredibly important to us ❤️💙

name: COBBLEVERSE 1.7.40
changelog:
![COBBLEVERSE 1.7.40 Update](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/126336f15656259dfe3c1b291c3bf332a1ee9215_0.webp)

## COBBLEVERSE 1.7.40

### 🧭 Exploration & Navigation
* **Trainer Card Update:** The trainer card now offers an option to view the series progress graph in-game (click the rotating arrows button to the left of the region name). This allows you to view the full list of trainers and Gym Leaders left to defeat all the way up to the Champion, along with the specific Level Cap for each of them
* **Better Pokédex Scanner:**
    * Scanning with your Pokédex now provides detailed environmental data (biomes, weather, time) and party-based threat level coloring
    * You can now scan Restoration Tanks to view the restoration progress, check the exact Pokémon inside, and register unseen Pokémon in your Pokédex directly through the tank
* **Waystone Interface Overhaul:**
    * Added a scrollable waystone list, completely replacing the old pagination system
    * Added personal aliases for waystones via a new "Personal Settings" button, allowing you to assign a custom name (perfect for multiplayer servers with generic names)
    * Added a "Favorites" checkbox in the Personal Settings to pin frequently visited locations
    * Added a "Sort" button to cycle the list between Manual, Alphabetic, and Distance
    * Added a dedicated "Manage Waystones" screen, enabling drag-and-drop rearranging and safer deletion controls
* **Waystone Filters & Groups:** Added group filters to the selection screen, featuring built-in categories ("Global Waystones", "Favorites", and per-dimension tabs). You can also create personal, custom groups with unique text colors and icons
* **New Waystone Variants:** Added Red Nether Bricks, Purpur, Prismarine, and Mud Bricks Waystones
* **New Exploration Items:**
    * **Epitaph:** Keeping this item in your inventory upon death will consume it and spawn a Fleeting Memorial at your death site. You can then use a waystone to teleport directly there (the option disappears once used)
    * **Twinbound Feather:** Wave it against another player's feather to link them. If both players have their linked feathers, you can teleport directly to each other via any waystone
    * **Portal Scroll:** Spawns a physical portal to a specific destination that lasts 5 minutes, allowing players, mobs, and items to pass through. Teleport back to it anytime by selecting the new "Return to Portal" option on a waystone

### 🐲 New Mega, G-Max & Animated Models
* **New Animated Models:** Added fresh animated models for Articuno, Moltres, Zapdos, Clawitzer, Cubone, Marowak, Galarian Farfetch’d, Sirfetch’d, Goomy, Sliggoo & Hisuian Sliggoo, Goodra & Hisuian Goodra, Grimer, Muk & Alolan Muk, Makuhita, Hariyama, Houndoom, Jigglypuff, Wigglytuff, Toxapex, Mawile, Misdreavus, Mismagius, Pikipek, Trumbeak, Quagsire, Salazzle, Starly, Staravia, Toucannon, Toxel, Toxtricity, Vigoroth, Jangmo-o, Hakamo-o, Kingdra, Larvitar, Pupitar, Togepi, Phione, Manaphy, Victini, Galvantula, Chesnaught, Gothita, Gothorita, Gothitelle, Skorupi, Drapion, Minccino, Cinccino, Munna, Musharna, Electrike, Manectric, Snorunt, Glalie, Froslass, Pheromosa, Foongus, Amoonguss, Flutter Mane, Virizion, Mew, Mega Eelektross, and Mega Scovillain.
* **Gigantamax Additions:** New G-Max models for Copperajah, Coalossal, Pikachu, and Blastoise
* **Mega Evolutions Revamped:** New animated models for Mega Charizard X, Mega Charizard Y, and Mega Salamence
* **Zygarde:** Added a new animated model for Zygarde Core
* **Animation Overhauls:** Improved existing animations for Basculegion, Galarian Weezing, Bounsweet, Escavalier, Greninja / Mega Greninja, Grimmsnarl, Honedge, Doublade, Aegislash, Incinaror, Kommo-o, Hisuian Lilligant, Sceptile, Serperior, Swampert, Empoleon, Meditite, Medicham, Minior and Zygarde 50%

### 👾 Pokémon Mechanics, Cries & Mounts
* **End Game Protection:** A Shiny Rayquaza spawning in The End will no longer despawn if the player moves too far away before capturing it!
* **New Mount Options:** Added Flutter Mane and Garbodor as rideable mounts
* **Shoulder Mounts:** Phione and Manaphy can now sit on the player's shoulders
* **Pokemon Cries:** Added cries for Articuno, Zapdos, Moltres, Raikou, Suicune, Regigigas, Phione, Manaphy, Minccino, Cinccino, Electrike, Manectric, Gothita, Gothorita, Gothitelle, Jangmo-o, Hakamo-o, Makuhita, Hariyama, Houndoom, Mawile, Pikipek, Trumbeak, Starly, Staravia, Staraptor, Toucannon, Toxel, Toxtricity, Croagunk, Toxicroak, Duskull, Dusclops, Dusknoir, Kricketune, Amoonguss, Foongus, Meditite, Medicham and Zygarde Core
* **Visual Improvements:** Added a new model for the Mewtwo Fetus inside the Resurrection Machine
* **Mega Stones:** Removed unused Legacy Mega Stones from the game, as they have been fully succeeded and replaced by **Mega Showdown** stones

### ⚔️ Raids & Battles
* **Dynamic Battle Overlay:**
    * **Live Info:** Added a draggable left-edge player party strip with hover panels for moves, PP, stats, ability, held item, and weaknesses that activates during wild and trainer battles
    * **Opponent HUD:** Added a draggable right-side opponent info strip that preserves revealed opponent battle info across switches
* **Starter Adjustments:** Selecting Pikachu as your starter Pokémon now grants Thunder Shock as its default move (previously, it spawned with only non-damaging status moves)

### 🛠️ World & Structures
* **New Biome:** Added the hazardous Sulfur Caves biome
* **Cinnabar Blocks:** Added Cinnabar, Polished Cinnabar, Cinnabar Bricks, and Chiseled Cinnabar
* **Sulfur Blocks:** Added Sulfur, Polished Sulfur, Sulfur Bricks, and Chiseled Sulfur, alongside Potent Sulfur and Sulfur Spikes
* **Raid Den Balance:** Made Raid Den Crystals more common throughout the world.
* **Decorations:** Wooden lanterns now emit a full light level of 15 (up from 10) and can now be dynamically hung on the sides of blocks, walls, and fences

### 🎼 Audio & Visuals
* **Soundtrack Expansion:** Added 5 new background music tracks: Unova Route 1, Route 4, and Route 10 by Pokestir; Aspertia City and Unova Bike Theme by Zame
* **New Music Disc:** Added the "Safari Zone" music disc by Zame. It has a rare chance to be found inside Mineshaft Chest Minecarts within the Sulfur Caves biome, and outputs a redstone comparator signal of 8
* **Jukebox Integration:** All background tracks and discs are now properly indexed and viewable inside the Jukebox UI (accessible by pressing "J")
* **Audio Clean-up:** All music discs have been renamed to "Poké Disc" (with the exception of "Lava Chicken"). Incorrect track descriptions on select discs will be addressed once our music update is complete, ensuring CurseForge users get 100% Pokémon music compatibility
* **Atmosphere Management:** Reorganized background music triggers via our main resource pack to better control themes across every biome. Future updates will focus on volume balancing. If you'd like to help us out, join our Discord: **https://discord.lumy.fun**
* **In-game Toasts:** Enabled standard game toast notifications. These are useful to track your progression, such as showing you a helpful reminder to press the "C" key to choose your starter when you first spawn, or notifying you when new PC Box wallpapers are unlocked during exploration. 
* **Resource Pack Status:** Pressing and holding the "T" key on the Resource Pack menu will now display an upper-right notification confirming that resource packs have reloaded successfully
* **Menu Cleanup:** Removed the Pokémon 30th Anniversary branding logos

### ⚙️ Technical & Optimization
* **GPU & Rendering Boost:** Significantly optimized world rendering performance, netting up to +115% FPS on select hardware configurations
* **Reduced Stuttering:** Reduced latency spikes and micro-stutters during world chunk updates
* **Thread Optimization:** Teleportation mechanics no longer block the main server thread while loading chunks, preventing severe lag spikes on lower-end servers
* **Menu Upgrades:** Polished text formatting and layouts across various menu screens. The modpack's version number (e.g., "1.7.40") is now clickable and links directly to the full changelog
* **Session Loading Visuals:** The client now snaps a screenshot when leaving a world or server, displaying it as a seamless loading backdrop upon your next join
* **General Polish:** Dozens of underlying minor bug fixes and quality-of-life adjustments

name: COBBLEVERSE 1.7.31

![COBBLEVERSE 1.7.31 Update](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fb42254b9f7ec948430afd4eb6f462a5b1ed414d.png)

## COBBLEVERSE 1.7.31

### ⚔️ Raids & Battles
* **Raid Visuals:** Raid crystals now emit sparkling particles when active
* **Dynamic Beams:** New raid crystal beam visuals with **dynamic scaling** based on Raid Tier
* **Raid Fixes:** Solved issues where players would get stuck in raids after leaving
* **Enhanced Battle Log:**
    * Added bracketed move links with tooltips
    * Added damage percentage display to damaging moves
    * Added clickable color themes and a new **Pink Theme** option
* **Dynamic Battle Overlay:**
    * **Live Info:** Pokémon now feature a real-time HUD above their heads during battles
    * **Dynamic Display:** Instantly view **Pokémon Names, Level, Health Bar, Types**, and any active **Status Conditions** without needing to target them directly
* **Battle Info Panel:**
    * Now displaying full weakness charts (just hover over any Pokémon's info panel)
    * **Resistance** rows added to the **weakness tooltip** for a complete defensive overview
    * Added **Priority** to move tooltips
    * Added **Speed** to switch-screen tooltips
* **Strategic Switching:** Added effectiveness info on switch-screen party slots with per-opponent breakdowns
* **Damage Previews:** Judge each move's potential before swapping in with switch-screen damage previews
* **Expanded Stat Panels:** Revealed info for moves, abilities, and held items, plus full type breakdowns
* **Battle AI:** Adjustments to switch evaluation, making trainers less likely to switch unnecessarily
* **Battle Stability:** Reduced/resolved crashes/disconnects when **Zygarde** shifts to Complete Form or during Mega Evolution

***

### 🧭 PokéNav & Exploration
* **Details Tab:** PokéNav Location/Fishing screens now feature a "Details Tab". Click any entry to see spawn results, rarity, and specific conditions
* **Automatic Cataloging:** PokéNav now records nearby Pokémon instantly, **fully revealing their entry** (no more hidden silhouettes)
* **PokéSnack Integration:** Using PokéNav on a PokéSnack block now displays spawner data, including active effects
* **PokéFinder Rework:** Completely redesigned UI with unlimited filters. The radar now displays Pokémon matching at least one filter and includes a real-time counter on the left
* **Bucket Aspects:** Spawn buckets are now saved in Pokémon data. You can filter by rarity (e.g., `spawn_bucket=ultra-rare`) or properties (e.g., `type=rock`)

***

### 🐲 New Mega Abilities
* **Mega Feraligatr:** Gains the **Dragonize** Ability (Normal-type moves become Dragon-type with 1.2x power)
* **Mega Meganium:** Gains **Mega Sol** (Moves act as if Sunny Day is active)
* **Mega Emboar:** Gains **Mold Breaker** (Moves ignore the target's Ability)
* **Mega Dragonite:** Gains **Multiscale** (Reduces damage taken when at full HP)

***

### 👾 Pokémon Models & Textures
* **New Animated Models:** Mega Dragonite, Regigigas, Wo-Chien, and Ultra Necrozma
* **New G-Max Forms:** Added Gigantamax **Drednaw, Garbodor, Duraludon, and Orbeetle**
* **Improved Models:** New animated models for **Celebi** and **Shaymin** (CurseForge only)
* **Shiny Fixes:** Fixed Lugia Shadow Shiny texture
* **Discovery:** Added "First Discovery" popups for new Pokémon and forms
* **Log Cleanup:** Addressed many missing Mega Showdown ID errors in the logs

***

### 🛠️ World & Structures
* **Gym Changes:**
    * **Ferruccio’s Gym:** Now spawns in the Sandstone Valley to prevent crashes/lag previously caused by the Volcanic Crater
    * **Lake Verity:** Now generates in Sakura Valley biomes
* **Dynamic Positioning:** Most battle structures now automatically arrange players and Pokémon during Gym Leader, Elite Four, and Champion encounters for a more immersive experience
* **Structure Loot:** Loot adjustments for Kanto League, Johto League, Sandra's Gym, Angelo's Gym and Ash's House
* **Ash’s House:** Removed the backpack due to persistent bugs/glitches
* **League Access:** Improved chat warnings for players trying to enter the Champion's room before defeating the Elite Four in Hoenn and Sinnoh
* **Spawn Corrections:**
    * Fixed Team Rocket Scientist spawns in Team Rocket Towers
    * Fixed Alolan Meowth and Persian spawns
* **Legendary Summon:** Added a **Summon Anchor** for Lugia in the Whirl Islands
* **Core Conversion:** Added a recipe to turn a Zygarde Core into 9 Zygarde Cells
* **Regi Ores Overhaul:** Adjusted generation settings to make Regi Ores more frequent and better balanced
* **Rock Ore Update:**
    * Now spawns in **Badlands, Eroded Badlands, and Wooded Badlands** biomes
    * Generation height: between **Y=75 and Y=135**
    * **New Texture:** Updated visuals to match **Terracotta** (previously generated within Dripstone)
* **Steel Ore Update:**
    * Now generates within **Dripstone Caves**
    * Generation height: between **Y=-50 and Y=10**

***

### 🏗️ Elevator & Additions
* **The Elevator:** Added a new **Elevator Block** (finally fixing teleport issues for those without command blocks enabled!)
    * **Creative Config:** Shift+Right Click with an empty hand to set a Y-offset
    * **Activation:** Teleports players when receiving redstone power (e.g., via a pressure plate)
    * **Security:** Can be restricted to players who have completed a specific Advancement
* **Mount Improvements:**
    * Riding a **Fire-type** Pokémon now grants fire/lava immunity (with no flames on screen)
    * Riding a **Water-type** Pokémon allows you to breathe underwater (oxygen bar stays full)
    * Fixed the "hyper-acceleration" bug for Miraidon and Koraidon
    * Many new mounts added and lots of existing ones have been adjusted.
* **Badge Box:** First Gym Leaders now drop their region's Badge Box only the first time they are defeated
* **Structure Locators:** Gym locators now work directly from the Creative menu and `/give` command (crafting is no longer mandatory for them to function)
* **TM Recipes:** Changed the Secret Power TM recipe to avoid conflicts with Nature Power

***

### 🎊 Dynamic Raid Cheer System
* **Smart Replenishment:** Upon entering a Raid, the mod checks your inventory and provides only the necessary Cheers to bring your total to the threshold (Default: 3)
* **New Configs (LumyMon):**
    * `giveCheersOnRaidStart`: Toggle auto-distribution on/off
    * `raidCheerCount`: Customize how many Cheers players receive
* **Loot Protection:** If auto-distribution is off, Cheers obtained as boss drops will not be cleared when leaving the raid

***

### 🎼 Audio & Visuals
* **Atmosphere:** New music for the Raid Cave
* **Music Disc Fixes:** The **Pokémon Yellow Bike Theme** now plays correctly on its music disc
* **Performance Tweaks:** Particle Rain, lighting management, and sky effects have been optimized to increase speed
* **Rechiseled GUI:** Redesigned the interface to match the modpack’s aesthetic and resolved layout misalignment issues

***

### ⚙️ Technical & Optimization
* **General Performance:** World loading and chunk generation are significantly faster in our test environments
* **Mod Compatibility:** Resolved issues with **Vanilla Backport**, **Sophisticated Storage**, and **Sophisticated Backpacks**
* **Bug Fixes:**
    * Fixed missing dialogues
    * Fixed XP popups to use translated Pokémon names
    * Fixed the Tell & Pat Gym freeze (only Gardevoir will Mega Evolve now)
    * Prevented Legendary Monuments spawner from losing textures when clicked with Ominous Trial Keys
    * Giratina Altar now correctly removes nearby Dripstone Blocks upon activation
* **Localization & Tooltips:**
    * **French Translation:** Full support added (Thanks **Hifelhim**!)
    * **COBBLEVERSE Advancements:** Now available in Korean (Thanks **시우**!)
    * **Radar:** "Any" region renamed to **"Overworld"** for better clarity
    * **Formatting:** Cleaned up tooltips (e.g., "Ltsurge" → **"Lt. Surge"**)

***

## ⚠️ IMPORTANT

name: COBBLEVERSE 1.7.30th Anniversary
changelog:
![COBBLEVERSE Modrinth Update 30th Anniversary](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b4be3b74305aff8339072cb9beabc7373d974322_0.webp)

## **COBBLEVERSE 1.7.30** – Celebrating Pokémon's 30th Anniversary!

### 🚀 **NEW FEATURE: Cobblemon Raid Dens**

Mysterious **Raid Crystals** have appeared! These portals teleport you to a dedicated dimension to engage in cooperative or solo boss battles.

* **Strategic Challenges**: Difficulty tiers from 1 to 7 Stars. Face off against **Terastallized**, **Dynamaxed**, or **Gigantamaxed** Pokémon. You might even encounter **Paradox** Pokémon, **Ultra Beasts**, or, rarely, **Legendary and Mythical** Pokémon
* **Raid HUD & Visuals:** A custom overlay displays the Boss icon (with Mega support), Tier, Type, and a server-synced reset timer
* **Raid Cheer System:** Upon entry, you are automatically granted **9 Cheers** (3x Heal, 3x Attack, 3x Defense). Use up to 3 per battle to turn the tide for you and your friends (**up to 4 players**)!
* **Guaranteed Capture:** Defeating a Raid Boss guarantees a successful catch. Tier 5-7 raids may also drop **Max Mushrooms**
* **Custom Arena:** Battles take place in a massive, exclusive arena to accommodate even the largest Gigantamax foes
* **Community Feedback:** We have added raids for nearly 1000 Pokémon. We need your feedback to fine-tune the balance of these encounters!

***

### ⚙️ **Balance and QoL**

* **Ball Comparison Panel:** The "<" key now works out of combat while looking at a wild Pokémon with a ball in hand
* **Poké Snack Blacklist:** You can now block all or specific Legendaries, Mythicals, Ultra Beasts, and Paradox Pokémon from Poké Snacks via **[lumymon.json](https://modrinth.com/mod/lumymon/version/0.6.1)**
* **Battle Forfeit:** You can now flee from wild battles without physically moving away 20 blocks
* **Captured Pokémon:** Captured Pokémon now display a Poké Ball icon next to their name to easily identify them
* **Rarity Overhaul:** Adjusted global spawn rates:
    * _Common:_ 88.5% | _Uncommon:_ 10% | _Rare:_ 1.2% | _Ultra-Rare:_ 0.3%
* **League TP:** Added a TP system to return to the Hall from the Champion's Room in Kanto and Johto Leagues

***

### 🛠️ **Fixes and Improvements**

* **Performance:** Improved FPS and frame stability during prolonged battles
* **Mounts:** Re-tuned speeds (Legendaries are now the fastest) and added missing flight sound effects
* **Forfeit Menu:** Forfeit screen in trainer battles now correctly shows the confirmation menu
* **Permission Integration:** Added `lumymon.altar.use` (Active by default). Server owners can now manage altar access without granting global /pokespawn permissions (tested with LuckPerms)
* **Audio:** Added a custom track to the Raid dimension
* **Structure Localization:** The **Secret Key** and **Turbine Key** now correctly locate the corresponding Team Galactic structures (**Eterna Building** and **Wind Plant**)
* **Map Icons:** Fixed the **Split Decision Temple** icon not appearing on maps
* **Type Corrections:** Fixed Alolan Vulpix and Ninetales types
* **Baltoy Spawn:** Now spawns correctly in Badlands and Desert biomes only
* **Missing Dialogue:** Fixed missing dialogue for Misty
* **Ursaluna Spawn:** Fixed Bloodmoon Ursaluna spawn
* **Newmoon Island:** Removed the hammock to prevent accidental explosions
* **General Tweaks:** Many other tweaks and improvements

***

**New Mods:**

* _Cobblemon Raid Dens, Catch Indicator_

**Updated Mods:**

* _Cobblemon Battle Extras, Cobblemon Catch Rate Display, Cobblemon: Mega Showdown, Cobblemon: PlayerXP, Entity Model Feature, Fabric API, [LumyMon](https://modrinth.com/mod/lumymon), Not Enough Animations, Repurposed Structures, Tom’s Simple Storage, Waystones_

***

From the humble beginnings in **Kanto** to the chaotic **Tera Raid Dens** of **Paldea**, embark on an **epic journey celebrating 30 years of Pokémon** adventures! 

_We eagerly await your feedback on the new Raid system. May your journey be legendary, and may you catch them all! **Have fun!**_ ❤️💙

name: COBBLEVERSE 1.7.3
changelog:
![COBBLEVERSE 1.7.3 Update](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/882c59ac5972b5100763f9b896cd69f06a4afbd5_0.webp)
## 🌌 COBBLEVERSE 1.7.3
### The Sinnoh Saga & The Fate of the Universe

The struggle for the fate of the world begins now. **Team Galactic** has established multiple bases across the world, and only you can stop their plan to recreate the universe. Powered by our custom **LumyMon** mod, this update introduces unique, immersive systems specifically designed for **COBBLEVERSE**. Over **20 new structures**, **3 new dimensions**, and lots of new custom mechanics await you.

---

## 🌌 Team Galactic & The Red Chain
Confront the Commanders in exclusive custom structures to uncover the path to the "Pokémon of Myth"

**Custom Galactic Structures:**
- **Wind Plant:** A multi-level energy facility. Infiltrate the floors to find **Commander Mars**. Defeating her yields the **Verity Proof**, the only item capable of revealing the location of **Mesprit**.
- **Eterna Building:** A 5-story vertical high-tech facility filled with scientists and server rooms; **Commander Jupiter** guards the summit. Defeat her to obtain the **Acuity Proof**, required to locate **Uxie**'s lake.
- **Team Galactic HQ:** An immense fortress featuring four towers, dormitories, offices, museums, gyms and hidden secrets. Find **Commander Saturn** here to receive the **Valor Proof** and use it to locate **Azelf**

- **The Final Confrontation:** Locate and battle **Leader Cyrus**. Only by defeating him can you seize the **Red Chain** before he uses it to subjugate the **Pokémon of Myth**

- **Spear Pillar:** Craft the **Space-Time Radar** to locate this ancient temple. Among the ancient ruins, two massive statues of **Dialga and Palkia** await the call of the **Red Chain**. By placing the **Adamant Orb** or **Lustrous Orb** into the **Altar of Space-Time**, the Red Chain will bind the energy of the statues, bringing them to life for an epic encounter
* **Galactic Trainers:** Now feature fully **animated skins** and corrected textures

---

### The Temple of Sinnoh & Arceus
* **Azure Flute:** Crafted from celestial flutes and Distortion materials. Playing it _(outside of combat only)_ teleports you to the **Origin Dimension**
* **Personalized Instances:** Every player receives a unique Temple location. Re-playing the flute returns you exactly to your previous Overworld coordinates
* **Ancient Legends**: Meet and challenge **Damon & Perula** _(Adaman & Irida)_ to obtain the **Adamant Crystal** and **Lustrous Globe** for **Origin Forme** transformations.
* **The Almighty Arceus:** Place all **18 Arceus Plates** on the pedestals to begin the ritual. Arceus will manifest in one of its many forms to face you

### The Distortion World & Giratina
* **Turnback Cave:** A deep underground labyrinth. Infiltrate Galactic archives to find **Selina’s Old Journal** and discover its coordinates
* **The Gateway:** Enter the Distortion World, a realm of broken reality. Use the **Distortion Cartography Table** and **Giratina Radar** to find Giratina’s Island
* **Returning Home:** Use the **Distortion Portal** to instantly return to your spawnpoint from the Distortion World

### Nightmares & Dreams: Cresselia & Darkrai
* **Crescent Isle:** Find the Mariner’s Logbook in shipwrecks and confront **Elfio** to earn the **Member Card** and locate **Fullmoon Island**, where Cresselia awaits pure-hearted travelers
* **Nightmare Dimension:** Every player is isolated in their own unique nightmare instance. Use the **Moonlight Amulet** to enter, holding it while sleeping, and a **Lunar Wing** to escape... Or be ready to face your deepest fears against Darkrai!
* **The Weaver:** Collect Nightmare Strings to craft the trap for **Darkrai**

---

## 🐲 LEGENDARY ENCOUNTERS & PROGRESSION
* **Lake Guardians:** Encounter Hisuian Zoroark, Overqwil, and Goodra in exclusive Lake structures. Pass their trials to summon **Uxie, Azelf, and Mesprit** and collect the Jewels needed to reforge the Red Chain
* **The Rise of Eternatus:** Mine **Galar Particle Ores** to hatch the **Eternatus Cocoon** found in End craters
* **Stark Mountain:** Battle Buck and Charon to recover the Magma Stone. Smelt it in the **Stark Forge** to summon **Heatran**
* **Treasures of Ruin:** Find Sacred Stakes in the Nether to break the seals of **Wo-Chien, Chien-Pao, Ting-Lu, and Chi-Yu**
* **Regi Temples:** Awaken **Regigigas** at Snowpoint Temple after you have caught all five other Regis
* **Legendary Balancing:** Disabled Poké Snacks for Legendaries to ensure these encounters remain epic, unique milestones

---

## 🎨 VISUALS, FORMS & ANIMATIONS
* **Mega Evolution Z-A:** Added all **45 new Mega Evolutions** (including Mega Darkrai, Mega Heatran) with official **Mega Showdown** recipes
* **Armored & Shadow Forms:** Equip **Rocket Armor** on Mewtwo or use the **Shadow Soul Stone** on Lugia for custom visual/audio transformations _(now with a short cooldown)_
* **Rideables & Models:** Added dozens of new rideable Pokémon (Koraidon, Miraidon, etc.) and updated models for Celebi, Shaymin, and Meloetta
* **Animations:** **72 Pokémon** have received complete animation overhauls for better immersion

---

## ⚔️ ENHANCED BATTLE INTERFACE
A comprehensive new UI providing:
* **Team Intelligence:** Preview opponent’s team count and specific Poké Ball types
* **Real-time Data:** View type advantages, weather, terrain, turn counters, and detailed move tooltips (Power/Accuracy/PP)
* **Controller Support:** Native support now available during battles (enable in config)
* **Cinematic Positioning:** Automated positioning centers players and Pokémon in arenas during key battles (e.g., Team Galactic structures)
* **Catch Rate Interface:** Real-time catch percentage display based on the Ball you are holding. You can also display a real-time comparison UI for every Ball type

---

## 🛠️ TECHNICAL UPDATES & WORLD GEN
* **Flight System:** Reintroduced **Roll** for non-fixed horizons. Default riding perspective is now **First-Person** _(customizable)_
* **Minimap:** Press **"X"** to toggle an enlarged, **4x zoom** scouting map. All Pokémon icons are now correctly displayed
* **Ores & Loot:** All new ores feature emissive textures and sounds
* Transitioned to a **Dynamic Loot Table** system for most of the new structures
* **Backported Features:** Backported Minecraft 1.21.6 features to 1.21.1, including the **Pale Garden** biome and Resin mechanics
* **Tera Pouches:** Store up to 1216 Tera Shards in a single organized item
* **Shaders:** Overhauled **"COBBLEVERSE - Shaders"** with improved lighting, wind effects, and atmospheric End/Overworld skies
* **Decorative Blocks:** Added **600+ new blocks**, including 3D models for Potions/Status items and 16 colored **Plaques**
* **Capacity:** PC storage increased from 40 to **60 boxes**

---

## ⚖️ ECONOMY & BALANCING
* **Merchant Rework:** Rare items (Max Revives, Rare Candies) removed from basic shops to encourage exploration. Max Revives are craftable via Campfire Pots
* **Spawn Pool Overhaul:** 99% of spawns are now managed by our custom **COBBLEVERSE-DP** for precise balancing with Cobblemon 1.7.3
* **Banking:** All food items can now be sold to the **CobbleMerchant Bank**
* **Catch Rates:** Real-time catch percentage display based on the Ball you are holding.

---

**And much, much more!** You can find a more detailed Changelog here: **[COBBLEVERSE 1.7.3](https://www.lumyverse.com/cobbleverse/cobbleverse-upcoming-releases/)** and find lots of information on our Wiki: **[Wiki.lumy.fun](https://wiki.lumy.fun)**. We will do our best to update all information as soon as possible!

---

## ⚙️ Updates & Technical Changes

#### 🛠️ Core Updates
* **Updated to Fabric Loader 0.18.4**
* **Updated to Cobblemon 1.7.3**
* **Shaders:** Updated **Complementary Shaders Unbound** and meticulously tuned settings for enhanced lighting, wind effects (grass/sugar cane), and improved atmospheric skies (Overworld/End).

#### 📦 Updated Mods
* Accessories, Accessories Compatibility Layer, Balm, Beautify: Refabricated, Carved Wood, Cobblemon Capture Xp, Fight or Flight Reborn, Mega Showdown, Pasture Loot, PlayerXP, Tim Core, Cobbreeding, Comforts, Entity Culling, Entity Model Features, Entity Texture Features, Euphoria Patches, Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin, FerriteCore, Forgiving Void, GeckoLib, ImmediatelyFast, Lithium, **LumyMon**, **LumyREI**, MoreCobblemonTweaks, Not Enough Animations, Particle Rain, Ping Wheel, Radical Cobblemon Trainers & API, TMCraft, Waystones, Xaero’s Minimap & World Map, Zoomify.

#### ➕ Added Content
* **Mods:** Cobblemon Battle Extras, Cobblemon Battle Positions, Cobblemon Catch Display, Fusion, **Legendary Monuments (Customized)**, Navas’ Z-A Mega, Platform, **Rechiseled**, SuperMartijn642’s Config/Core Lib, **Tom’s Simple Storage**, Vanilla Backport.
* **Resource Packs:** **CobbleMotion**, AllTheMons x Mega Showdown.

#### ➖ Removed Content
* **Mods:** Badge Box, Cobblemon UI Tweaks.
* **Resource Packs:** Navas-Z-A-Mega RP, SwirlixAndSlurpuff RP, Z-A-Mega-DP.

#### 🎨 Resource Pack Updates
* **MissingMons:** New **Celebi** (shoulder-mountable) and **Shaymin** models.
* **UI & Icons:** E19 Cobblemon Minimap Icons, Icon Xaero's X FreshAnimations.
* **Models & Animations:** Fully Hisuian Starters, Hydro Reanimodel, AllTheMons x Mega Showdown.
* *All dependencies have been updated to the latest version to support original creators.*

---

### ⚠️ **WARNING:** This update involves significant changes to world data and dimensions. **BACKUP YOUR WORLDS** before playing. 

>**IMPORTANT!**: After updating, launch the game, go to Resource Packs, hold **`T`** for 3 seconds, then click **Done**.

**Note on Translations:**
We are currently updating our translations. Many strings are currently incomplete due to the volume of new content. We welcome community help to translate COBBLEVERSE into your language!

---

**COBBLEVERSE 1.7.3** is already available for 1-click installation on **[Apex Hosting servers](https://apexhost.gg/LUMYVERSE)**!

Apex has also upgraded their update system to automatically handle datapack replacement, which prevents potential version incompatibilities. It’s incredibly seamless now _(and we made sure to test it ourselves. Better safe than sorry!)_

For the best experience with all the new content in this version, we strongly recommend a plan with **6GB+ RAM** (or more, depending on your expected player count).

---

Thank you for your incredible support and patience during this development cycle! ❤️💙
